A significant concentration of Bug nests has been identified, impeding industrial expansion of Gehenna. 

In response, the Mobile Infantry has mobilized its cutting-edge firepower to swiftly address the issue and catch the Arachnids off guard.
Destroy all Stinger Nest and Brood Nests
Complete the Main Objective as fast as possible

column2: Hephaestar aims to expand its fuel extraction industry in this sector, but a formidable Arachnid infestation stands in the way.
An elite Mobile Infantry force has been deployed to tackle the threat, using a signature approach that never fails: overwhelming firepower!
Today's operation has significantly weakened the Arachnid presence in the sector, paving the way for industrial expansion.
The Arachnid infestation has proven to be too strong for even our most advanced weapons. Hephaestar will have to look elsewhere to expand its industries.
A massive surge in Arachnid activity has been detected in the surrounding mountains. The Bugs must have realized their predicament and are flooding down to defend their nests.
The weather forecast for today is heavy ash with sporadic spells of sunshine. These storms will surely interfere with the flow of reinforcements.
The ash storm is about to engulf the sector in darkness. Because dropships can't fly in such extreme conditions, any transfer of reinforcements will be disrupted.
Thick ash clouds are passing over the sector. All air support has been suspended until the skies clear up again.
The skies have cleared temporarily but more ash clouds are on the way.
